name: Site Research
tagline: Turns a local-business dossier into a search and maps gap brief
description: Reads a dossier on one local business and writes up where it is exposed across standard search, answer engines and map listings. The output stays in draft. It does not email anyone, pitch anyone, or hunt for fresh prospects - the work ends at the written brief on the desk.
author: itsryanlenk
